summary: Completed authenticated API regression and browser smoke testing. Core login, registration, protected routes, task CRUD, comments API, search, dashboard, role permission, board/list toggle, task modal editing, logout, and mobile overflow checks were exercised.

minor.issue: allow_origin_regex permits any HTTP/HTTPS origin instead of an explicit configured frontend origin.
No brute-force lockout/rate limiting after repeated failed credentials.
Deleting a nonexistent task still returns 200 rather than 404.
Updating a nonexistent member returns 200 without verifying matched_count.

ui_bugs.issue: Task modal has no comment list or comment composer, so the required task comment UI is not available despite working comment endpoints.
Members, My tasks, Calendar, notification, and settings controls are visual-only/no-op controls; Members does not navigate to a member-management screen.

action_items: Add comment list/create UI to the task modal and connect it to the comment endpoints.
Implement Members screen/navigation and wire role updates for admins.
Replace broad CORS regex with explicit configured origins and add login brute-force protection.
Return 404 when task/member update or delete targets do not exist.
critical_code_review_comments: Several sidebar/topbar controls are rendered as anchors or buttons without handlers, leaving requested member management and simple notifications incomplete.
The API currently accepts any origin through a regex while allowing credentials; restrict this before production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for exercised core flow; requested comment/member flows not implemented

seed_data_creation: Created one temporary test member via registration and promoted it to admin; created TEST_ui_task/TEST_ui_task_edited and TEST_comment_ui during browser checks. The API regression task was deleted; temporary member/UI task data may remain because no member-delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API and core desktop/mobile browser flows pass. Focus retest on task comment UI, Members navigation/role editing, notifications, and hardened auth/CORS behavior. A browser-only second pass initially lacked login because browser context cookies are not persistent between runs; this was a test setup issue, not an application finding.
rca of the issue: The comment API exists at /api/tasks/{task_id}/comments, but TaskModal only renders task fields and save/delete controls; no comment fetch or submit code exists. Navigation items are static <a> elements with no href/onClick and notification is a button without a handler, so these requested workflows cannot be reached from the UI. Backend hardening gaps are directly visible in server.py: broad allow_origin_regex, no failed-login tracking, and missing matched_count checks on delete/member update.
